title: AC1024 two-point dynamic-block parameter DXF profiles

source.fixturePolicy: Used the existing local input only. No DWG/DXF fixture was added to Git. Selector-generated output files were temporary and removed.

observations: BLOCKLINEARPARAMETER source handles 1110 and 1114 carry the shared AcDbBlock2PtParameter connection lists followed by the AcDbBlockLinearParameter fields and value sets.
BLOCKFLIPPARAMETER source handles 1118, 111D, and 1156 carry the flip caption/state/location/value/tooltip tail; handle 1156 also carries XDATA with a coordinate tuple.

BLOCKHORIZONTALCONSTRAINTPARAMETER handle 1165 and BLOCKVERTICALCONSTRAINTPARAMETER handle 1160 carry an AcDbBlockConstraintParameter dependency handle, the shared AcDbBlockLinearConstraintParameter body, value-set fields, and distinct final subclass markers.
The horizontal and vertical parameter records carry persistent reactors; independent JSON identifies their expression names and values as W/-19.6528394930898 and H/-15.19823363933608, respectively.
independentStructuralComparison.limits: LibreDWG is an independent structural/field comparison only; it does not establish native dynamic-block semantics, full graph closure, or consumer acceptance.

implementation.dxfRead: AC1024-only exact shared two-point prefix and per-subclass tails for FlipParameter, LinearParameter, HorizontalConstraintParameter, and VerticalConstraintParameter. Counts, schema tags, handles, finite values, trailing XDATA shapes, and group order are bounded. Unknown/malformed suffixes remain raw-only. DXF point components in trailing XDATA are reconstructed as one typed DRW coordinate while raw groups retain physical component order.
implementation.dxfWrite: AC1024-only typed serializers validate shared connection code/name arrays, declared value-set counts, finite coordinates/scalars, handle domains, strings, and group/byte limits before atomic publication. Constraint dependency handles are remapped at serialization.
implementation.adapter: Adds adapter-side projection helpers and dynamic-block DXF class metadata for these profiles to support later graph binding. The physical witness exercises the typed writer directly; it does not qualify staged whole-graph adapter emission. Complete-document admission remains closed.
implementation.notQualified: No native dynamic-block semantic qualification, complete owner-graph conversion, whole-document output qualification, or format-wide support claim.

fastRegression.result: PASS, 4/4. The new two-point selector covered four record types, DWG/DXF schema tags, ASCII/Binary output, exact raw group order, typed fields and XDATA readback, reactor handles, unknown-tail raw-only fallback, failed-write destination preservation, and corrected same-writer retry.

physicalWitness.result: PASS. All seven physical AC1024 parameter records were serialized individually to ASCII and Binary DXF and freshly re-imported. Typed body fields, XDATA values, reactor handles, constraint dependency values, and raw group order matched the source projection.

validation.fullSuites: NOT RUN; focused warning-as-error builds, four fast writer regressions, and the physical-source selector were sufficient for this bounded profile.
